method: Compared each effect at 0.55, 0.65, 0.75, 0.85 and 0.95 seconds in the four fx motion sheets; checked single-effect audit media and editable controls.

decisions.observation: Dense irregular color noise covers the frame. Unlike the clean chromatic edge offset and RGB split effects, this changes the surface texture and reads as a noisy signal fault; the display name now describes that output.

The frame is cut to a feathered oval window with large opaque black outer space on this isolated stage. This visible crop is different from the grid, color block, horizontal mirror and vertical flip treatments; size, placement and feather remain editable.

Dark curved edges focus the lit center, while the existing neon glow brightens edges and highlights. The available angle values visibly change the vignette and are saved, undone and exported by the audit.
